name: handwriting-mcp
description: Turn text, or every row of a CSV, into realistic handwritten notes. Renders locally; nothing leaves your machine.
long_description: Renders text as realistic handwritten notes and saves them as images. Set up a style once in a local designer page with a live preview (handwriting, ink, realism, finish, crop), then render single notes or one personalised note per row of a CSV or spreadsheet using {column} tokens.

tools.name: open_note_designer
tools.description: Open a local page to set up how notes look, with a live preview.

tools.name: render_note
tools.description: Render text as a handwritten note image.

tools.name: render_notes_batch
tools.description: Render one personalised note per row of a CSV/TSV/XLSX file.

tools.name: list_note_options
tools.description: List saved styles, fonts, inks, finishes and surfaces.
